en.headline: Election Committee polls close with 98.79 per cent turnout as counting begins
en.dek: Officials said 5,640 of 5,709 eligible electors voted by 6pm on Sunday; Electoral Affairs Commission chairman David Lok called the result encouraging.
body: Polling for the 2026 Election Committee Subsector Ordinary Elections closed at 6pm on Sunday with a final turnout of 98.79 per cent, according to the Registration and Electoral Office.

A total of 5,640 of the 5,709 eligible electors cast ballots. Electoral Affairs Commission chairman David Lok said he was encouraged by the turnout, which he said demonstrated that Hong Kong’s electoral system has become increasingly mature.

Ballot boxes were delivered to the Central Counting Station at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre, where counting began. Lok said results were expected throughout the evening. Authorities received one complaint related to election advertisements.

zh.headline: 選委會選舉投票結束 投票率98.79% 點票展開
zh.dek: 選舉事務處公布，截至周日傍晚6時共5640人投票，投票率達98.79%；選管會主席陸啟康指結果令人鼓舞。
body: 選舉事務處公布，2026年選舉委員會界別分組一般選舉於周日傍晚6時結束，最終投票率為98.79%。
5709名合資格投票人中有5640人投票。選舉管理委員會主席陸啟康表示，對高投票率感到鼓舞，顯示本港選舉制度操作越趨成熟。
各票箱已運抵香港會議展覽中心的中央點票站展開點票，陸啟康指結果將於今晚陸續公布。當局接獲一宗涉及選舉廣告的投訴。
